ja: 私たちの電車、30分遅れてるけど、それでも乗り換えには間に合うと思うよ。
en: Even though our train is 30 minutes late, I think we'll still make our connection.
alternatives: Our train is 30 minutes late, but I think we'll still make our connection.
Although our train's running 30 minutes late, I think we can still make the transfer.
point: 「それでも」は still。「乗り換えに間に合う」は make the connection

ja: 駅員さんに頼んで、乗り換えの行き方を紙に書いてもらったんだ。
en: I had the station staff write down the transfer route for me.
alternatives: I got the station staff to write down the transfer route for me.
I asked the station staff to write down how to transfer for me.
point: have＋人＋動詞の原形で「人に〜してもらう」。get なら to が要る

ja: すみません、空港行きのバスがどこから出るか教えていただけますか？
en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bus to the airport leaves from?
alternatives: Excuse me, would you mind telling me where the airport bus leaves from?
Excuse me, could you tell me where I can catch the bus to the airport?
point: 疑問文を埋め込むと語順は where the bus leaves。from を忘れずに

ja: ごめん、乗ってる電車が遅れてるの。
en: Sorry, my train is running late.
alternatives: Sorry, the train I'm on is running late.
Sorry, my train is delayed.
point: 今まさに遅れている電車は is running late

ja: 次のバスが何時に来るか、駅員さんに聞いてみて。
en: Try asking the station staff when the next bus comes.
alternatives: Try asking a station worker when the next bus comes.
Try asking the staff at the station when the next bus is.
point: 「〜してみて」は try + -ing。try to do は「努力する」

ja: 運転手さんに、駅で私たちを降ろしてくれるよう頼んでくれる？
en: Can you ask the driver to drop us at the station?
alternatives: Can you tell the driver to drop us at the station?
Could you ask the driver to let us off at the station?
point: ask + 人 + to do で「人に〜するよう頼む」

ja: 東京駅までの往復切符を2枚と、路線図を1枚いただけますか？
en: Could I have two round-trip tickets to Tokyo Station and a route map, please?
alternatives: Can I get two round-trip tickets to Tokyo Station and a route map, please?
I'd like two round-trip tickets to Tokyo Station and a route map, please.
point: tickets は複数形、map には a を忘れずに

ja: 彼女が乗る予定だった電車、大雪で運休になっちゃった。
en: The train that she was supposed to take was canceled because of heavy snow.
alternatives: The train she was supposed to take got canceled because of heavy snow.
The train she was going to take was canceled due to heavy snow.
point: 「乗る予定だった電車」は the train (that) she was supposed to take

ja: この機械で切符を買えますか？
en: Can I buy a ticket from this machine?
alternatives: Can I get a ticket from this machine?
Can I buy tickets at this machine?
point: 「この機械で」は from this machine が自然

ja: バス、もう行っちゃったのかも。停留所に誰もいないよ。
en: The bus might have already left. There's nobody at the stop.
alternatives: The bus may have left already. There's no one at the stop.
The bus might have gone already. Nobody's at the stop.
point: 過去の推量は might have + 過去分詞

ja: この時間は道がすごく混んでるから、タクシーより電車のほうがたぶん早いよ。
en: The train will probably be faster than a taxi because traffic is really bad this time of day.
alternatives: Taking the train will probably be quicker than taking a taxi, since the roads are really busy right now.
The train's probably faster than taking a taxi because traffic is terrible at this hour.
point: 「〜より早い」は faster than。「道が混む」は traffic is bad が自然

ja: すみません、この電車は渋谷に止まりますか？
en: Excuse me, does this train stop at Shibuya?
alternatives: Excuse me, is this train stopping at Shibuya?
Excuse me, will this train stop at Shibuya?
point: 「止まる」は stop at。主語が this train なので does を使う
